update.releaseNotes:
v5.8.2 - Changelog
New --- - Add support for the 2026-07-01 game patch: per-scenario stat caps and a soft cap at 1200, where stat points beyond 1200 are now worth half instead of roughly an eighth. - Add a `Read Stat Caps from Screen` option to the `Training` page (on by default) that reads each stat's live cap every turn, so cap increases from sparks and inheritance are respected. - Add handling for the URA Finale `Happy Meek's Challenge!` duel, picking the contest with the best odds on a stat you actually want, plus a `Happy Meek Duel Bias` option in `Scenario Overrides` that steers training onto the facility carrying the duel badge. - Add the Unity Cup `Extreme Spirit Burst` tier, along with `Burst Failure-Chance Exemption`, `Extreme Burst Minimum Stat Gain`, and `Burst Only Top 3 Stats After Junior` options in `Scenario Overrides`. - Add a `Retry Unity Cup Races` option to `Scenario Overrides` that re-runs a lost Unity Cup race until it is won. - Add a unified `Schedule` page with `Race Solver` and `Recreation` tabs, replacing the separate `Smart Race Solver` and recreation settings pages. - Add an `Estimated Rank` to the redesigned `Remote Log Viewer`, with stat meters and a `Skills` panel that lists the trainee's owned skills. - Add a structured decision trace and per-factor score breakdown to the training logs, explaining why each training was picked. - Add `Rainbow Detection`, `Spirit Gauge Detection`, `Umamusume Details Read`, and `Scrollbar Detection` debug tests. - Add an at-a-glance status zone to the `Home` hero card, with chips for the active race strategy, skill plans, and armed debug test.
Adjustments --- - Update game data up to `Bamboo Memory 2026-07-06`. - Improve rainbow detection to not rely on orange relationship bars. - Read the trainee's conditions and owned skills from the `Details` dialog. - Decide whether to train or rest from all five facilities instead of the Speed failure chance alone. - Ignore the training blacklist during Pre-Debut and Junior Year so support card bonds still build. - Race an active fan or trophy requirement before pre-summer training, and skip the race screen entirely when no G1 is available for a G1-only trophy. - Lower the Trackblazer `Maximum Consecutive Races` default from 5 to 3. - Skip fan-farming extra races when energy is below a floor. - Spend leftover skill points on the final purchase of a career, so points that would otherwise be lost are put to use when the `Career Complete` skill plan is active. - Open `Scenario Overrides` on the scenario selected on `Home`, and migrate the settings pickers to a modal selector. - Redesign the `Event Log Visualizer` timeline and year cards to align with the current UI design. - Improve scroll list detection by finding the scrollbar via brightness and shape.
Fixes --- - Fix phantom training failure-chance reads by using a digit-constrained OCR engine and rejecting impossible values. - Fix mandatory races running on a stale turn and cancelling their own retries. - Fix aptitudes `E` and `D` being misread as `B`. - Fix the `Details` dialog stat read discarding stats above the cap. - Fix the `Remote Log Viewer` search filter being lost on refresh. - Fix `Open Data Directory` buttons not pointing at the chosen storage folder. - Fix the `Victory` event default not matching its dropdown option. - Fix circle and cross skills being OCR'd as trailing letters, and the double-circle skill glyph being read as a single circle.
